The structure of Ca8Mg2Bi2O16 (reduced formula Ca4MgBiO8) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi and Mg centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ca centers show four O neighbors and O centers adopt 5- or 6-vertex environments. Corner-sharing between Bi and Mg octahedra is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 28 sites.
